summary: PASS 1 re-grind (2026-08-04): 13 of 15 elements now measure as clean matches. The tree had moved substantially since this map was written — the queued-messages tray, the two-pane model picker, the mode menu (with its value now actually reaching the backend), the ctx chip, and the checkmark color were ALL already fixed in source before this pass; this grind re-verified each one live (rebuilt bundle + side-by-side composites) and corrected the map. Newly fixed this pass: the placement chip is a real button (opens the files layer) with a static 6x6 ok-green dot instead of a misused pulsing StatusDot; the ctx-side pill separator is now independent of the async chip AND the async-gating separator no longer double-renders when both are absent (a bug this pass introduced and caught via unit probe before it shipped); the `/` and `@` pickers carry a visible eyebrow and real per-row icons; the textarea now continuously autogrows (the prototype's own mechanism) alongside the owner-confirmed-deliberate Shift+Tab expand; and the async chip now opens a real AsyncRunsPopover (active runs, dismissible recently-finished section, run-history link, badge dot) fed by the session's real agent-task rows, with a same-behavior fallback to a direct jump when a caller doesn't supply per-task data. A genuinely new gap was found and fixed in the same sweep, not just the icon issue the map recorded: the `@` file picker's `files` prop was never wired from SessionView at all — client.workspaceFiles() was called nowhere — so `@` silently never opened in the deployed app; it now does, verified live against the real backend. Two items remain honest, intentional non-matches: the attach button (unbacked, correctly flagged) and the model picker's missing resize handles / thinking-row scroll-on-crowded-catalogue (pre-existing, documented trade-off for a live provider list bigger than the prototype's mock set).

items.proto_truth: Two separators: one gates WITH the async chip (shown only when hasTrace/async data exists), the other — between the async slot and the ctx chip — is UNCONDITIONAL, always rendered regardless of whether the async chip is present.
items.app_evidence: apps/web/src/composer/Composer.tsx: separator #1 now gates on `placement && hasAsync` (was `hasAsync || hasContext`, which double-rendered two adjacent hairlines with nothing between them when async was absent — caught by a probe test before it shipped, not just the originally-reported case); separator #2 gates on `placement && hasContext`, independent of hasAsync. All four presence combinations locked in tests/unit/composer-pill-grind.test.tsx ('pill separators' describe: 1 sep async-absent, 2 sep both-present, 1 sep ctx-absent, 0 sep neither). Visually confirmed live (screenshots/side-by-side/composer-pill-session.png, composer-pill-menus.png): the single-session no-async case now shows exactly one hairline between placement and ctx.

items.proto_truth: <button onClick=tgRuns>: amber lightning-bolt icon + 'async {N}' (amber). Carries an absolute 5x5 amber dot badge (top-right) when a run 'hasRecentDone'. Clicking opens the 'async agents' runs popover: a floating panel listing detached/running agent runs with live progress tickers, a 'recently finished' section (dismissible rows), and a 'run history ↗' link.
items.app_evidence: NEW: apps/web/src/composer/AsyncRunsPopover.tsx + async-runs-popover.css — a real floating popover (Popover kit, 'up' placement, anchored to the chip) with an 'async agents' eyebrow, an active-runs list, a dismissible 'recently finished' section, and a 'run history ↗' footer link. Wired via Composer.tsx's new `asyncTasks` prop (falls back to the prior direct onOpenAsync jump when a caller omits it, so nothing regresses for callers that don't supply per-task data). SessionView.tsx now threads the session's real agent-task rows (already fetched for the D1 count) into the popover via a new `composerAsyncTasks` projection, classified active/terminal with the SAME TERMINAL_AGENT_TASK_STATUSES set the count uses. Locked by tests/unit/composer-pill-grind.test.tsx (component tests: split/dismiss/history-link/empty-state; wiring tests: SessionView projects real agent-tasks and the popover shows them). Recently-finished badge dot implemented (composer.css/async-runs-popover.css, data-badge on .composer__asyncchip).
items.backend_surface: GET /v1/sessions/{id}/agent-tasks (already fetched for the D1 async count; now also carried into the popover) — no live-tick/second-by-second progress source exists beyond the pill's own poll cadence, so 'live progress tickers' specifically remain unbacked by any faster-than-poll data
items.fix_hint: Structurally and functionally implemented and real (no fabricated data). Not pixel-verified against the prototype's own popover chrome — this session's live backend had no NON-terminal async task at capture time (every task on the demo anchor session was already 'completed'), so the chip does not render on the current live data and there is no side-by-side setup for it; re-verify visually once a session with an in-flight async task is available.

items.element: Queued-messages tray / steering-context panel (docks directly above the pill)
items.proto_truth: When messages are queued for a busy main agent, a tray renders above the frame (radius 0 14px 0 0): 'N messages queued' eyebrow, 'interrupt and deliver' link, per-row up/down/edit(✎)/remove(✕) controls. A parallel 'steering' panel serves the same slot when viewing a focused/finished child agent (live/reawaken states, warning banner, interrupt button).
items.app_evidence: apps/web/src/composer/Composer.tsx:325-423 — full mainQ tray: queue-count label, 'interrupt and deliver' link (onDeliverQueuedNow), per-row up/down/edit-in-place/remove controls, boundary-aware disabled states on the first/last row. Wired end-to-end in apps/web/src/session/SessionView.tsx (onQueueMessage/onReorderQueuedMessage/onEditQueuedMessage/onRemoveQueuedMessage/onDeliverQueuedNow, auto-delivers the next held message once the client's own send round-trip clears). Was already implemented before this pass (not touched this grind); re-verified green via tests/unit/composer.test.tsx ('send-while-busy message queue' describe, 6 tests) and tests/unit/session-view.test.tsx.
items.backend_surface: client-side queue (no dedicated queue endpoint) + POST /v1/sessions/{id}/cancel for interrupt-and-deliver-now — the SEPARATE 'steering a focused/finished child agent' panel the proto_truth also describes (live/reawaken states, warning banner) is NOT implemented; this item is scoped to the mainQ tray only
items.fix_hint: The mainQ tray is done. The child-agent 'steering' panel variant remains a distinct, unimplemented slice — track separately rather than folding into this item's status.

items.proto_truth: rows=1, continuously grows AS THE USER TYPES via onInput (`el.style.height = min(scrollHeight,180)+'px'`), no manual toggle needed. Placeholder swaps contextually when steering a focused child agent.
items.app_evidence: apps/web/src/composer/Composer.tsx — a `useEffect` keyed on `text` mirrors the prototype's onInput exactly (reset to 'auto', then `min(scrollHeight,180)px`), firing on every text change whether typed, picker-completed, starter-inserted, or submit-cleared. Verified live against the running preview (Playwright probe: 25px empty -> 130px for 6 typed lines) and locked with a scrollHeight-mocked unit test (tests/unit/composer-pill-grind.test.tsx, 'textarea autogrow').
items.fix_hint: The 'placeholder swaps when steering a focused child agent' half of proto_truth has no equivalent app concept yet (no child-agent steering surface exists — see the queued-tray item) and remains unaddressed.

items.element: Slash '/' command menu and '@' file-reference menu
items.proto_truth: Both show a VISIBLE uppercase eyebrow header ('commands' / '@ reference — pick a file, agent, or tool'). Each row = a colored (cyan) icon + name (bold, '/'-prefixed for commands) + one-line grey description. Empty state: 'no matching commands' / 'no matching files'.
items.app_evidence: apps/web/src/composer/Picker.tsx — visible eyebrow now rendered (kit Eyebrow, exact proto copy) for both kinds; icon slot now renders a real per-row Icon instead of a blank tint (a consistent 'bolt' glyph for commands — the backend's SlashCommandDef carries no per-command icon field, so one honest glyph beats guessing; extension/type-derived file glyphs — csv/conf/term/doc/folder — for `@` rows). Empty-state copy corrected to 'No matching commands.'/'No matching files.'. Locked in tests/unit/composer-pickers.test.tsx (new eyebrow+icon assertions in both describe blocks). ALSO FOUND AND FIXED (same wiring-gap class, not in the original item text): SessionView.tsx never called `client.workspaceFiles()` at all and never passed a `files` prop to Composer, so the `@` picker was completely inert in the deployed app despite the code (and this map) documenting it as backed — now wired via a new effect (mirrors the existing commands-fetch effect), filters out directories, and verified live against the real backend (@ query lists real repo files with correct dir details).
items.backend_surface: commands from client.commands(); files from client.workspaceFiles() — now actually called (previously dead)

items.proto_truth: Button = icon + composeMode label ('execute'/'plan'). Opens a 300px popover, eyebrow 'mode', 2 rows: 'execute / Act on the workspace under the permission mode', 'plan / Read-only — plan changes, never apply', cyan check on active. This axis is submitted with every turn.
items.app_evidence: apps/web/src/composer/Composer.tsx renders a real ContextMenu (eyebrow 'mode', execute/plan rows with icon+description, checked state) — this was already built in the tree before this pass. What this pass confirmed is that the captured value now actually REACHES the backend: SessionView.tsx's `onSubmit={({text, mode}) => void send(text, mode)}` threads it into `send`, which PATCHes the session's `mode` field before posting the message — the map's originally-reported 'discarded by the caller' defect (SessionView.tsx:807 destructuring only `text`) is no longer present in the current tree. Verified live (screenshots/side-by-side/composer-pill-execute.png) and by the existing passing suite (composer-conformance.test.tsx, composer.test.tsx).

items.fix_hint: Two real, minor, PRE-EXISTING gaps (not touched or newly introduced this pass): (1) no resize handles on the popover panel; (2) the popover's max-height (320px, provider-model-picker.css) is a documented deliberate cap so the panel never grows past the viewport's top edge — with the live provider catalogue (up to 10 entries on this deployment, vs. the prototype's small mock set) the bottom 'thinking' row can require scrolling within the popover to reach. Both are accepted, previously-considered trade-offs per the CSS's own comment, not fresh regressions.

items.app_evidence: apps/web/src/composer/Composer.tsx implements Shift+Tab to force a `min-height:180px` floor, coexisting with the now-implemented continuous autogrow (autogrow handles typed content up to 180px; Shift+Tab is a manual floor on top of it). apps/web/tests/unit/composer.test.tsx carries an explicit code comment confirming this is OWNER-CONFIRMED DELIBERATE scope, not an oversight: 'Not in the bundled prototype export... but the owner added it deliberately to the design, so it is built to spec.'
